name: Teardrop Floater
description: Attack the lane, then lift a soft, high-arcing one-hander over the outstretched arms of the big man before you reach the rim.
game: NBA Finals Game 2, Spurs vs. Heat

name: Step-Back Three
description: Sell a dribble move, then plant and push backward off one foot to create space and launch a high-arcing three.

name: Up-and-Under Reverse Layup
description: Drive baseline, go up and under the rim past the shot blocker, and finish with the opposite hand on the far side of the basket.

name: Hurdle Dunk
description: Catch the lob in stride, then leap clean over the defender in your path and throw it down with authority.
